# Build or repair this repository's website

Use `.github/agents/site-builder-orchestrator.md` and `site.config.json`. Inspect current branch and live repository before editing. Execute the full workflow, repair failures, update documentation and work log, commit on a focused branch, and open a PR when governance requires one. Preserve private content and ask only for an external owner-only action. Report exact validation results; do not call an untested site complete.
